players.product: Data-center electrical distribution equipment (the 'powertrain'): medium/low-voltage switchgear and switchboards, transformers, automatic transfer switches, PDUs, eHouses and prefabricated modular power skids (Powertrain Solutions)

quarterly_data.signal: Manufacturing and supply (10-K): campuses in Minnesota, Texas, Maryland, California and Mexico total approximately 2.3 million square feet; the 2025-2026 Capacity Expansion Plan, substantially completed in fiscal 2026, added 1.8 million square feet - replacing the Commerce, California campus with a new one in Vernon, California, expanding Waco (Texas), Hanover (Maryland) and Tijuana (Mexico) and building a new campus in Dayton, Minnesota; no material additional capital expenditures for the expansion are expected past fiscal 2026. Purchases of property and equipment were $115.9 million in fiscal 2026 versus $84.1 million. Most raw materials and sourced goods are bought on a purchase-order basis rather than long-term contracts; Forgent relies on a single supplier for certain specialized insulation material used in its transformer products, and in certain international markets uses contract manufacturers for complete products.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 purchases of property and equipment $115.9 million (FY2025 $84.1 million); no material additional expansion capex past fiscal 2026; single-source transformer insulation material
